entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-015. It's for the new cycling shoes. I saved up for them and was so excited.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now... VF886-015. I see the order was delivered about 25 days ago. Can you tell me what the issue is with the shoes?
They just don't work for me. I tried adjusting the cleats, but no matter what I do, they gave me terrible blisters on my first long ride. My feet were just torn up.
Oh, that sounds really painful. I'm sorry you had that experience.
It was. And honestly, I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years. I really needed this money back if they weren't going to work out. It's just a lot of money to have wasted.

I completely understand. Let me just confirm our policy for you... Okay, good news. Since it's a standard item, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? You can? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
